class.name: SteamAudioServer
class.brief_description: This is a singleton that handles all SteamAudio global state. You should not interact with it directly.
class.description: Owns the Steam Audio context, scene, simulator, HRTF, sources, geometry, and probe batches. [SteamAudioConfig] initializes and advances it automatically; application code normally should not call [method tick].

method.name: get_singleton
method.description: Returns the extension's global server instance.

method.name: tick
method.description: Submits current source and listener inputs, runs direct simulation, schedules reflections, and updates pathing. Called automatically each physics frame by [SteamAudioConfig].
